cases.first_sql: SELECT c."Cust_ID", c."Customer_Segment", f."Transaction_Value" FROM (SELECT t."Transaction_ID", t."Transaction_Value", cc."Cust_ID", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc."Cust_ID" ORDER BY to_date(t."Transaction_Date", 'DD-Mon-YY'), t."Transaction_ID") AS rn FROM credit_card_transaction_base t JOIN credit_card_card_base cc ON t."Credit_Card_ID" = cc."Card_Number" JOIN credit_card_fraud_base fr ON t."Transaction_ID" = fr."Transaction_ID" WHERE fr."Fraud_Flag" = 1) f JOIN credit_card_customer_base c ON f."Cust_ID" = c."Cust_ID" WHERE f.rn = 1 ORDER BY c."Cust_ID"
cases.final_sql: SELECT c."Cust_ID", c."Customer_Segment", f."Transaction_Value" FROM (SELECT t."Transaction_ID", t."Transaction_Value", cc."Cust_ID", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc."Cust_ID" ORDER BY to_date(t."Transaction_Date", 'DD-MM-YY'), t."Transaction_ID") AS rn FROM credit_card_transaction_base t JOIN credit_card_card_base cc ON t."Credit_Card_ID" = cc."Card_Number" JOIN credit_card_fraud_base fr ON t."Transaction_ID" = fr."Transaction_ID" WHERE fr."Fraud_Flag" = 1) f JOIN credit_card_customer_base c ON f."Cust_ID" = c."Cust_ID" WHERE f.rn = 1 ORDER BY c."Cust_ID"

cases.first_sql: SELECT t."country", c."corruption_index", u."unemployment_rate" FROM world_economic_tourism t JOIN world_economic_corruption c ON t."country" = c."country" JOIN world_economic_unemployment u ON t."country" = u."country" WHERE t."percentage_of_gdp" > 0.05 AND t."receipts_in_billions" > 0.5;
cases.final_sql: SELECT t."country", c."corruption_index", u."unemployment_rate" FROM world_economic_tourism t JOIN world_economic_corruption c ON t."country" = c."country" JOIN world_economic_unemployment u ON t."country" = u."country" WHERE t."percentage_of_gdp" > 0.05 AND t."receipts_in_billions" > 0.5;

cases.first_sql: SELECT o."customer_id", (s."delivery_date"::date - s."shipment_date"::date) AS wait_days FROM online_shop_orders o JOIN online_shop_shipments s ON o."order_id" = s."order_id" WHERE s."carrier" = 'UPS' AND o."total_price" < 100 AND s."shipment_date" = (SELECT MAX(s2."shipment_date") FROM online_shop_shipments s2 JOIN online_shop_orders o2 ON s2."order_id" = o2."order_id" WHERE o2."customer_id" = o."customer_id" AND s2."carrier" = 'UPS' AND o2."total_price" < 100) ORDER BY o."customer_id"
cases.final_sql:
WITH ranked_shipments AS (
    SELECT
        o."customer_id",
        s."shipment_id",
        s."shipment_date",
        s."delivery_date",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY o."customer_id"
            ORDER BY s."shipment_date" DESC, s."shipment_id" DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM online_shop_orders o
    JOIN online_shop_shipments s ON o."order_id" = s."order_id"
    WHERE s."carrier" = 'UPS'
      AND o."total_price" < 100
)
SELECT "customer_id",
       ("delivery_date"::date - "shipment_date"::date) AS wait_days
FROM ranked_shipments
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY "customer_id";

cases.first_sql: SELECT oi."seller_id", SUM(oi."price") / NULLIF(SUM(oi."shipping_charges"), 0) AS ratio FROM ecommerce_order_items oi JOIN ecommerce_products p ON oi."product_id" = p."product_id" WHERE p."product_category_name" = 'electronics' GROUP BY oi."seller_id" ORDER BY ratio DESC, oi."seller_id" ASC LIMIT 1
